content: AeroSpace (source read via GitHub API, main branch): reference-type TreeNode class tree, weak parent, @MainActor; Workspace root -> TilingContainer(orientation h/v, layout tiles/accordion) -> Window leaves; separate FloatingWindowsContainer and macOS-native containers (fullscreen/minimized/hidden/popup). Weights are 'adaptiveWeight' in absolute points per container orientation; layoutTiles distributes delta = (length - sum(weights))/n each layout pass. Normalization: flatten single-child containers, enforce opposite orientation nesting. MRU stack per node. lastAppliedLayoutPhysicalRect/VirtualRect stored on nodes for mouse resize/drag. FrozenTreeNode value snapshot used for closedWindowsCache (lock screen defence).
